Ministry of Finance

Monthly review of accounts of Government of India upto September 2026 (FY 2026-27)

Posted On: 30 OCT 2026 5:02PM by PIB Delhi

The monthly accounts of the Government of India upto the month of September, 2026 has been consolidated and reports published. The highlights are given below: -

The Government of India has received ₹18,35,422 crore (50.3% of corresponding BE 2026-27 of Total Receipts) upto September, 2026 comprising ₹12,76,088 crore of Tax Revenue (Net to Centre), ₹4,80,732 crore of Non-Tax Revenue and ₹78,602 crore of Non-Debt Capital Receipts. ₹6,99,409 crore has been transferred to State Governments as Devolution of Share of Taxes by Government of India during this period which is ₹67,658 crore higher than the previous year.

Total Expenditure incurred by Government of India is ₹25,49,835 crore (47.7% of corresponding BE 2026-27), out of which ₹18,95,288 crore is on Revenue Account and ₹6,54,547 crore is on Capital Account. Out of the Total Revenue Expenditure, ₹6,46,010 crore is on account of Interest Payments and ₹2,22,905 crore is on account of Major Subsidies.
